_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: the self-contradicting-pack pass (B-022/23/24/33/35/36/38/39/41/44, SG-04) — 2026-08-20, twenty-nine packs and twenty-nine kits, clean tree
_raised: 3398/1912/635 -> 3543/1924/635 on the self-contradicting-pack pass, 2026-08-20. validate.py +145, attributed by running each function in isolation against this tree and against 30bfbc3: +58 validate_elevation_tokens_named (every --shadow-*/--*-glow a pack declares, named in its prose — 58 tokens across 29 packs); +14 validate_motion_bands (a press against the doctrine's band, plus every duration literal in a Components or Micro-interactions section against the pack's own tokens and the UI ceiling); +6 validate_release_register (duplicate CHANGELOG version, the Run stamps table, the missing-tag audit against UNTAGGED_RELEASES, and the declared exception that stopped being one); +6 validate_emphasis_base_layer (a banned weight or slant, per pack that bans one); +59 validate_status_vocabulary (the cross-pack status map in SURFACE_COMPOSITION.md, one existence check and one set-equality check per pack, plus the table-found check — it was prose until this commit and wrong in three places); +2 validate_pack_enumerations, which is the same count as before over one more site — package.json, the description npmjs.com renders. validate_radius_single_valued adds 0 on a clean tree by design: it calls check() only on a component that has two radii, so its floor contribution is zero and its proof is its plant. validate_palette.py +12: +7 validate_line_surface_collision (a line and a surface resolving to one colour, plus every token named in an '@role drawn-on:' list having to exist), +2 validate_pack and +3 validate_stated_ratios from instrument-console gaining --danger and --info, which its prose had legislated since its first release. sloplint.py unchanged, as expected — no colour moved and no lint target was added. Then 3543 -> 3550 on the B-001/B-002 close: +7 from validate_contract_declaration requiring a `Contract: core` line to NAME what it declines (one check per core pack, seven of them). `awning` shipped a bare `Contract: core` and the guard caught it on its first run — a narrow pack and an unfinished pack read identically until the declination is written down.
_not_raised_by_the_widening: Measured old-pattern-against-new on one tree: the widened separator adds 51 spans across all 1025 text files but only 2 inside the source list validate_counted_claims reads, which is why the floor moves by 2 and not by 51. The rest are in CHANGELOG.md, docs/audit/, docs/evidence/ and test/*.py -- historical narration ('the ten-heading contract', 'a nine-heading pack') plus one branch name, 3 of which the identifier exemption drops. Adding any of those files to the source list means adjudicating each span, not adding a regex escape.
